name: researchzy
description: Find and review the literature with real papers: search about 250 million records, manage your library and PDFs, and write literature reviews that cite only what the search returned. Needs a Researchzy account.

interface.shortDescription: Search papers, manage your library and review the literature.
interface.longDescription: Search by DOI, arXiv, title or keywords; manage your library, download PDFs and add your PDFs to library papers; and write a literature review with logged searches, screening and a synthesis that cites only papers the index returned. Needs a Researchzy account.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find papers in Researchzy and show their metadata and PDF availability.
